name: Liechtenstein
description: Liechtenstein from two lordships bought by a prince to a principality of the Holy Roman Empire, independence in 1806 and a rich small state.

checkpoints.name: The principality
checkpoints.note: The Liechtenstein princes bought Vaduz and Schellenberg and in 1719 made them a principality. It became sovereign in 1806.

checkpoints.name: A small neutral state
checkpoints.note: Liechtenstein gave up its army in 1868 and tied itself to Switzerland in 1923. Banking and industry made it one of the richest countries.
